messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert — elevated 5xx rate detected in region us-midwest (midwest1). gateway-frontend 5xx > 10% over 5m. Paging SRE on-call @Jamie.

Jamie: I'm on-call, I'll take it. Jumping into metrics & logs now.

Ashwin: seeing a big spike in 502/504 from the midwest edgepool -> origin timeout errors. backend latency for model-serving group is up ~600-800ms. error_ratio ~12% across gateway-frontend.

Marie: running quick checks on infra: `kubectl -n gateway get pods -o wide | grep midwest` shows several model-runtime pods in CrashLoopBackoff and a few with high RSS.

Ben: grabbing logs from the failing frontends, snippets:
```
[2026-08-12T14:07:02Z] gateway-frontend midwest1: upstream read timeout from model-runtime-3 (10.1.12.7)
[2026-08-12T14:07:07Z] gateway-frontend midwest1: 502 POST /v1/generate (latency=1620ms)
```

Lina: model-runtime-3 shows repeated GC/pause patterns and OOM hints in the container logs. Not seeing disk issues. Memory pressure looks correlated with a recent config push ~2h ago that bumped heap targets.

Jamie: OK — two immediate mitigation paths: 1) reduce traffic to midwest by shifting ~30% to us-east (capacity available), 2) drain and recycle the high-RSS model-runtime instances in midwest after quick snapshot. Any objections?

Ashwin: +1 to shifting traffic first so we avoid cascading errors. I can run the routing update. Also recommend pausing the recent config change.

Marie: agree, pause rollout for the heap-target bump. I'll revert the config on the runtime config service.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-237654, severity: P1. Notifying on-call escalation list.

Jamie: Ashwin, can you apply a temporary routing override? Start with 30% shift, hold for 5m, then evaluate. Command we've used before: `infractl route update --service gateway --from=midwest --to=us-east --percent=30 --reason="mitigation-237654"`

Ashwin: running now.
```
$ infractl route update --service gateway --from=midwest --to=us-east --percent=30 --reason="mitigation-237654"
Applied routing override id=ro-237654-1
```

Ashwin: Starting shift. Watching metrics.

Ben: After shift p95 latency in midwest dropped from 1.6s -> 850ms, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 4.5% within 90s. us-east saw a small bump but well within capacity.

customer-success: Heads-up — we're triaging customer impact. Early look: ~6% of active sessions routed to midwest experienced errors during spike window. We'll prepare targeted outreach for pinned customers.

Lina: I've rolled a restart for model-runtime-3 on two problematic nodes and reverted heap-target in config-store. Restart logs show processes came back clean and memory stabilized.

Kai: scaling midwest gateway frontends from 10 -> 20 instances as safety. `k scale deployment/gateway-frontend-midwest --replicas=20` in progress.

Marie: running a short healthcheck suite against warm pools and model runtimes, validating KV cache warmup.

Ben: follow-up metrics: overall 5xx now ~2% in midwest, token throughput back to ~95% of baseline. Still seeing a small tail of timeouts for a handful of pinned routes.

Jamie: Good progress. Two action items: temporary routing override stays for 30m while we complete drains and patch; prepare a post-incident rollback plan if errors reappear. Also flag pinned endpoints list.

Ashwin: noting pinned endpoints: 12 routes pinned to midwest, reaching out to product owners for temporary unpinning or failover.

customer-success: We've opened CS tickets for top 5 affected customers and posted an initial Statuspage entry: "Partial service degradation in US-Midwest — some requests may see errors or higher latency. We're mitigating."

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-237654 updated: mitigation in progress, routing override active, scaling and restarts executed.

Jamie: Will keep the thread as the coordination hub. Once routing override is fully relaxed and metrics stable for 30m, we'll move to recovery and postmortem. Assigning followups: Marie (config rollback verification), Ashwin (routing cleanup), Lina (heap/RAM root-cause), Ben (logs & timeline writeup), Kai (scale rollback plan), customer-success (customer comms summary).

Marie: Confirmed config rollback propagated to all midwest runtime nodes. No new heap bumps observed in last 10m.

Ashwin: preparing a gradual rollback of the routing override in 2 steps: 15% -> 0% with 5m observation.

Jamie: Thanks team. I'll coordinate postmortem and ensure RCA + concrete remediation (automated preflight for config bump, oom alarms, traffic-steer playbook) included. :thumbsup:

customer-success: We'll follow up with customers once we see final recovery window.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Monitoring note — 5xx back down to baseline in midwest. Incident still open for postmortem items.

Jamie: closing active mitigation. Last note: if anyone sees regression, re-open thread and call pager. Good work.
